Translation: I turn to Allah in repentance
In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful
O Possessor of Favor and Generosity
O Possessor of Favor and Power

Arabic text: يَا مُصْطَفِيَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O the One who chose Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
